id.description: The unique identifier for the chat

name.description: The name of the chat (for group chats)

type.description: The type of chat (direct message or group chat)

participantIds.description: Array of eNames of the users participating in the chat. Entity references are eNames: an @-prefixed W3ID such as @48468c9a-dc1b-5663-92fb-5e46e3d2a7f0. eNames are used rather than User profile MetaEnvelope ids because they are stable, self-describing, and resolvable without a profile envelope, which a newly provisioned eVault may not have yet.

lastMessageId.description: ID of the most recent message in the chat

updatedAt.description: When the chat was last updated

admins.description: Array of eNames of the chat's administrators.

ename.description: The chat's own eName, when the chat is backed by a group eVault.
